english: I wonder if Tesla-chan, Nine-chan,\nand Reki-chan are back yet?
They're scouting Black Fund HQ,\nso I doubt it'll be easy.
But if they can't do it,\nno one can. Let's trust them and wait.
Oh? Look who's talking.\nYou trusted them the least.
Shut up! And you -\nyou still doubt them?
If I doubted them, I'd be scouting myself!
Now now, let's calm down for a bit.\nWe still don't know the enemy's numbers or goal,\nso we'd better rest while we can.
Remu-san is right.\nThe enemy probably holds the 'Angel's Tear'\nand is after 'Gustave,' right?
A weapon that can erase a whole city in one shot,\nfired without limit from satellite orbit\nusing the 'Angel's Tear' energy…
We've got to stop that no matter what!
Just one shot -\nthe damage would be…\nI don't even want to think about it, desuu…
Indeed.\nWhatever it takes, let's stop it before it fires.
A satellite cannon floating in space -\nwe can't exactly go punch it directly.\nWould be nice if we could, though.
Of course you can't!\nHonestly, you think like a child!
Huh? We can't?
There might be some way, though?
There's no such thing!
Earth's atmosphere is over a thousand kilometers thick,\nand it's made up of the troposphere, stratosphere,\nmesosphere, thermosphere, and humans…
(Um… well, whatever… I'll keep quiet.)
Is something wrong, Hibiki-san?
Huh? Oh, it's nothing!\nWe've gotta do something about it, haha.
(I can't say it… I can't say I got there\non sheer momentum… and I couldn't do it again now…)
Sorry to keep you waiitingg!
…Intel acquired.
An unexpected situation.
Unexpected… how?
It seems the black group\nis trying to operate 'Gustave' from somewhere\nother than Black Trader HQ.
What do you mean?
Black Fund HQ: nothing unusual.\nNo one… was there…
At Black Trader HQ there's 'Fallen Angel,'\nthe activation device\nfor 'Gustave.'
But the black group doesn't need this activation device -\nthey're trying to run it with a different control device.
I've located where that control device is.
So that's why it took so long.
Fortunately, there's no sign 'Gustave'\nhas been activated yet.\nWe should still be in time to stop the launch.
Let's go at once!\nLead the way, please!
Yes!
The control device is in the port warehouse up ahead.
Let's hurry!
Should we have taken a vehicle, I wonder?
No, on foot was the right call.
Huh? Why?
One, two, three, four… close!
Hostiles, it seems.
I know you're there! Come out!
Sorry, but we don't have time to play.\nDisappear, or get a hole punched in you - your choice!
A hole, obviously.\nExcept the one getting holed is you!
I'll ask, just in case.\nWhat are you planning to do with 'Gustave'?
Isn't it obvious?\nI'm going to destroy this world.
I don't see the point.
…That's right, there is no meaning. Not in this world.\nA world where I'll never see Mama again\nhas no right to exist!
Mama…? What are you talking about?
I am a single bullet; a bullet has no human heart.\nTherefore, I think of nothing.\nI merely fly toward my objective.
…What is your objective?
A world full of hideous power -\nturn to ash!
Far more dangerous than power\nis that way of thinking!
Once 'Gustave Kai' activates,\nthe world heads straight for collapse!
'Gustave Kai'?\nWhat kind of modifications?
I might tell you if you win.\nWhich is impossible!
We can't waste time here!\nLet's finish this quickly!
I'll make it so YOU can't see Mama either…!!
Your mama…?\nDon't tell me she died…
Shut uuup!! Hole-punch!!
Tch - like I'd let you get me!!
I'll erase this world, no matter what!
Why does she hate the world so much…?
I merely fly toward my target…
Quota met. Withdrawing.
So it was a stalling tactic?\nMeaning 'Gustave'\ncan't fire yet?
'Gustave'?\nNo - 'Gustave Kai.'
Kai? What's different about it?
You mean it's modified?
Who knows? Which'll come first -\nyou learning that, or the world starting to end?\nWanna find out?
She got away… well, she achieved her goal.
There may still be enemies nearby.\nLet's do a little recon.
Right. From the way the black me talked,\nit sounds like it'll take a little more time\nbefore they can use that 'Gustave Kai' thing.
We can afford to be a little careful, then.
Where's Reki-san?
Scouting.
I am a single bullet; a bullet has no human heart.\nTherefore, I think of nothing.\nI merely fly toward my objective.
Objective… what is it?
My objective. The other me's objective.\nThe difference…?
I… she… what do we fly toward…?
The wind…
//END
